{{Quote|If Senks doesn't hand over the files he safeguards, once you've neutralized him, I advise destroying his database to eliminate it all.|Darth Vowrawn, to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Voice of an Empire: The Memoirs of Darth Baras''' was a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] accessible from the [[Darth Baras' spy network|database]] of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Senks]] that detailed [[Darth Baras]]' [[Darth Baras's coup|rise to power]]. [[Writing|Written]] by the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Baras, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] gave his personal account of himself in this memoir entry, though its contents were fictional and presented its author in a desirable light that detracted from what has transpired by then and was to come.

==History==
{{Quote|Only the most powerful, well-respected and influencial Sith stand a chance of becoming the Emperor's Voice. I was the perfect candidate.<br />But when the Emperor chose me, my apprentice grew jealous. In a fit of heretical treason, my former apprentice challenged me to a duel.<br />Through me, the Emperor judged my apprentice unworthy. Humbled, my apprentice bowed to my superior power and accepted death.<br />The next day, the Dark Council recognized me as the Voice of the Emperor.|An excerpt of the memoir in Senks' message to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" />}}
[[File:Darth_Baras_arrogant.png|thumb|left|280px|Darth Baras was a power-hungry Sith Lord with great ambitions and influence.]]
At around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR dates" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] had gained a new [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] whose powers were utilized by the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] to eliminate his rivals, including Baras' own Master, [[Darth Vengean]]. Taking his late Master's seat at the [[Dark Council]], a ruling body of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to which he served,<ref name="Power Play">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Power Play|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Darth Baras then became fearful of his increasingly strong [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] whom the new Dark Councilor thought threatened his personal ambitions. Thus,<ref name="Declaration of War">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Declaration of War|Quesh}}</ref> in [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="1-Date">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' establishes that the collapse of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] occurs in [[3641 BBY]], and the Sith Warrior storyline states that the Treaty of Coruscant collapses shortly after the death of [[Darth Vengean]] as a result of [[Plan Zero]].</ref> Councilor Baras arranged for the fledgling [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], though the apprentice escaped an early grave with the assistance of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]], and was appointed by them<ref name="Declaration of War" />&mdash;per the will of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], who the agents of the Hand served directly<ref name="The Emperor's Hand (Warrior)">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Emperor's Hand (Warrior)}}</ref>&mdash;the [[Emperor's Wrath]].<ref name="Declaration of War" />

Meanwhile, elevated to a higher position of power, Darth Baras dismissed his apprentice's survival and continued his plot to seize control of the Empire<ref name="The Voice of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref> via attempting to rescue his [[Parent/Legends|sister]], an infamous [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as [[Darth Ekkage]],<ref name="Thwart the Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Thwart the Rescue|Belsavis}}</ref> and by bringing the Dark Council to his reins. To that end, Baras [[Politics/Legends|wrestled]] before its other members through bribery and other means for the recognition of his claim to the mantle of the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]],<ref name="The Voice of Darkness" /> the liaison between the Council and their Emperor; the words of whom were communicated from and taken as the Sith Emperor's will.<ref name="Declaration of War" /> Though Baras' rescue of his sister was thwarted by his former apprentice, the Dark Councilor kidnapped the [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|Voice of the Emperor]] and made efforts to establish himself as the new, legitimate one.<ref name="The Voice of Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Voice of Darkness|Voss}}</ref> Manipulating fellow Councilors to his side, Baras' bid for the Emperor's Voice went unopposed openly save for the spirited Councilor, [[Darth Vowrawn]].<ref name="The Transponder Station">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Transponder Station|Transponder}}</ref>

Operating alongside Darth Baras' former apprentice, now the Emperor's Wrath, Vowrawn laid out his plan for crippling [[Darth Baras' spy network|Baras' power base]],<ref name="Protect Vowrawn">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Protect Vowrawn|Corellia}}</ref> which included the elimination of an [[Senks|Imperial operative]],<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" /> a [[Injaye|Jedi spy]],<ref name="Jedi Spy">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Jedi Spy|Corellia}}</ref> as well as a [[The Entity|prophet]].<ref name="Baras's Lair">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Baras's Lair|Corellia}}</ref> As they all were located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Vowrawn travelled to the world to coordinate the Wrath's [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|strikes]] on these targets that formed the pillars of Baras' organization there and allowed him leverage over other Dark Councilors during the false Voice's coup.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

[[File:Colonel_Senks.png|thumb|right|144px|An agent of Baras, Senks had access to a database that contained sensitive files of the Sith Lord.]]
Having already dispatched of Darth Baras' assassins sent to silence Vowrawn, the Dark Councilor's former apprentice moved for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] Senks, the Imperial operative. Implanted behind a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] resistance stronghold at [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Labor Valley]], Senks, an expert of technology, held his masters most sensitive files in a database maintained through a [[Computer/Legends|console]]-filled chamber at the rebel stronghold. Senks' network of technology at the stronghold failed him, however, as the Sith outsmarted the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy's]] contingency measures, blocking the colonel's escape passages with ion pulse disruptors whilst cutting through Corellian rebels towards the trapped Senks' chamber.<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" />

{{GameDS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Barging into Senks' sanctum, the Emperor's Wrath exacted revenge on Baras' servant, destroying the database that contained Baras' files, including the Sith Lord's [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] titled "Voice of an Empire: The Memoirs of Darth Baras." Darth Baras' wishes for his ultimate dominance of the Sith Empire as laid out in the memoir<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" /> were dashed, however, as he was soon defeated by his former apprentice.<ref name="Request An Audience">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Request An Audience|Korriban}}</ref> Thus, the false Voice's account of [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] was proven wholly false, as the apprentice&mdash;directly anointed the Wrath by the Emperor's Hand&mdash;saw to Baras' death per the Sith Emperor's will after being betrayed by the Darth, who lost the Dark Council's support in his last moments.<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" /><ref name="Declaration of War" /><ref name="Request An Audience" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Darth_Baras_duel.png|thumb|right|234px|Darth Baras fell to the Emperor's Wrath as a false Voice after writing his false memoir.]]
The memoir entry appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which the [[Sith Warrior]]-class player would receive an in-game mail that includes a recovered file of Darth Baras' memoir intended for the Sith Warrior's perusal which is sent by Colonel Senks, who does so out of gratitude after renouncing his loyalty to Dark Councilor Baras and reaffirming his shift of servitude to rival Councilor Vowrawn.<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" />

This is only possible if the [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] is spared by the player in the Sith Warrior-exclusive quest "Squeeze the Spy."<ref name="Squeeze the Spy" />
